question: Which article of Indian Constitution is related with the Conduct of business of the Government of a State?
solution:
The correct answer is __**166.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 4, i.e., Article 166 of the Indian Constitution, deals with the Conduct of Business of the Government of a State.**
 
• The article describes the procedure to be followed in the **State Legislature, including the conduct of proceedings, voting, and related matters.**
 
• The article also lays down the responsibilities of the** Governor, Chief Minister, and other Ministers in the State Government with respect to the conduct of business.**
 
• This article ensures that the State Government functions in a systematic and orderly manner and the interests of the citizens are protected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 132 **deals with the** Appellate Jurisdiction of the Supreme Court,** which means the power of the Supreme Court to hear appeals against the judgments of lower courts.
 
• ** Article 178** deals with the **Constitution of Legislatures in States, **which means the composition, powers, and functions of the State Legislatures.
 
• ** Article 144** deals with the** Enforcement of Orders and Decrees of Courts, **which means the duty of all authorities to enforce the orders and decrees of the courts within their jurisdiction.
